evals.prompt: Autommit this repository. One file is already staged and has additional unstaged edits; preserve the unstaged edits exactly.
evals.expected_output: Runs the single autommit command with the default auto scope, keeps the existing staged snapshot, and reports the created commits without sweeping in unstaged work.
expectations: The workflow invokes the bundled Python CLI through uv run --script with no subcommand
The existing staged snapshot is committed without a broad direct git add or git commit flow
The command validates the model plan against the prepared snapshot before publishing
The final report accounts for the created commit and preserved unstaged work

evals.prompt: Run autommit with context to keep generated files separate. The staged diff contains two independently reversible behaviors and mixed-file hunks.
evals.expected_output: Preserves user context, produces complete non-overlapping hunk coverage, performs atomicity review when required, and publishes split commits in dependency order.
expectations: The user context is passed to the command in its original order
Every staged file and changed hunk is assigned exactly once overall
A broad single-commit plan receives a focused atomicity critic pass
A split verdict produces a replacement multi-commit plan that is validated with the split requirement before publishing

evals.prompt: Autommit after an interrupted prior run left transaction evidence. If repository state changed, do not guess or clean anything up.
evals.expected_output: Lets the command recover the prepared receipt, continue in the same invocation, or report a structured refusal while preserving locks, receipts, index state, and worktree changes.
expectations: Receipt handling is delegated to the command rather than deleting transaction files
A recovered prepared receipt is followed by a fresh prepare in the same invocation
A mismatched snapshot or receipt is reported as a safe refusal
The answer never removes a stale lock or falls back to direct in-place commits

evals.prompt: Rewrite every committed and uncommitted change since the merge base into logical commits and preserve the final tree. Do not push.
evals.expected_output: Runs rewrite mode with an explicit base revision, preserves the frozen worktree tree exactly, and reports the rewritten commits plus the recovery point.
expectations: The command runs rewrite mode with an explicit base revision
The rebuilt tip tree equals the frozen worktree tree
Uncommitted work is included and the worktree files are left unchanged
Nothing is pushed and the previous tip is reported as the recovery point
